INDIANAPOLIS


, Oct. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Simon](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790668-1&h=4023794420&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.simon.com%2F&a=Simon) ®, a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations, today announced details for its third quarter earnings release and conference call.


Simon's financial and operational results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, will be released after the market close on November 5, 2026. Simon will host its quarterly earnings conference call and an audio webcast on November 5 from 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time.


The live webcast will be available in listen-only mode at[investors.simon.com](http://investors.simon.com/) . Interested parties can join the call by dialing:


- 1-844-826-3035 United States participants
- 1-412-317-5195 Participants outside the United States
- The conference ID for the call is "10212388."


An audio replay will be available from approximately 9:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 5, 2026 until 11:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 12, 2026. The replay can be accessed within the United States by dialing 1-844-512-2921. Callers outside the U.S. can access the replay at 1-412-317-6671. The replay passcode is "10212388." The call will also be archived on[investors.simon.com](http://investors.simon.com/) for approximately 90 days.


**About Simon**
[Simon](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4790668-1&h=4023794420&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.simon.com%2F&a=Simon) ® is a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations (Simon Property Group, NYSE: SPG). Our properties across North America, Europe and Asia provide community gathering places for millions of people every day and generate billions in annual sales.
